pillars.name: Social
pillars.story: Material deprivation, food insecurity and barriers to youth employment

cards.name: Poverty Headcount Ratio
cards.subtitle: A quarter of the population lived below the national poverty line in this historical survey.
cards.source: CSO / World Bank, Living Conditions in Grenada

cards.name: Moderate-to-Severe Food Insecurity Rate
cards.subtitle: Difficulty securing sufficient food remains a national development concern.

cards.name: Unemployment Rate and Youth Unemployment Rate
cards.subtitle: Youth unemployment is more than twice the overall rate in the same quarter.

pillars.name: Economic
pillars.story: Education and tourism earnings, living costs and external exposure

cards.name: Education Contribution to Gross Value Added
cards.subtitle: Education is Grenada’s largest listed industry—a major economic activity alongside tourism.
cards.source: CSO, Contribution of GVA by Economic Activity

cards.name: Inflation Rate
cards.subtitle: Prices increased slowly over the year; low inflation does not reverse earlier increases.

cards.name: Total Public Debt-to-GDP Ratio
cards.subtitle: Public liabilities are substantial relative to the economy, affecting development financing.

cards.name: Merchandise Trade Balance
cards.subtitle: Grenada buys substantially more goods abroad than it sells; services earnings are excluded.

cards.name: Visitor Expenditure
cards.subtitle: Tourism generates spending in Grenada, helping explain the services side of its economy.

cards.name: Real GDP Growth Rate
cards.subtitle: Grenada’s economy expanded in real terms; growth does not show how gains were distributed.

pillars.name: Environmental
pillars.story: Hurricane damage and dependence on diesel electricity

cards.name: Estimated Direct Economic Damage from Hurricane Beryl
cards.subtitle: Damage equivalent to 16.5% of 2023 GDP shows the scale of a single hurricane shock.
cards.source: World Bank / GFDRR, Hurricane Beryl GRADE

cards.name: Net Electricity Generation by Source
cards.subtitle: Diesel dominates electricity generation, linking energy transition with resilience and fuel exposure.
cards.secondary: Source values converted from kWh to GWh; these describe the Grenlec system.

counting_rule: Every distinct displayed statistical value counts, including contextual and secondary values. Dates, units and source metadata are excluded. Repeated labels of the same value do not add a fact.
pillar_limit_exception: User authorised a sixth economic indicator on 7 October 2026 while retaining the overall 15-fact maximum.
